case_classification.short_description: 3-SM for a company producing fruit juices and beverages

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an exceptionally complex FP&A and 3-statement modeling task that spans 69 SKUs and 24 raw materials across a 120-month forecast horizon. It requires building complex nested logic for dynamic machinery capex additions (triggered by an 80% capacity utilization cap), intricate energy consumption calculations based on machine runtimes, seasonal ingredient pricing mapping, a dynamic labor staffing model, and exact-date working capital (CCC) cycles. Additionally, integrating the 3-statements with seasonal tax payouts, 95% dividend distribution logic in specific months, and circular cash interest calculations makes this a heavyweight modeling test that would take an expert modeler approximately 6 hours of highly focused building and auditing to complete without errors.
